description: Generate a plausible domain-expert author (first name, last name, bio, and a bundled avatar) grounded in the brand's info, and save it as a new author. Returns the created author with its authorId. Never invents website/social links — add those afterwards with update_blog_author. Free. Pass save=false to preview without saving.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

language.description: Language code for the bio (e.g. 'en', 'cs'). Defaults to the brand's content language.

save.description: Default true: save the generated author. false returns the unsaved preview only.

name: generate_blog_author
